courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 明石海峽大橋
related.transfer: 可遷移「沿海峽配置橋型與海中基礎數」與「預組量測與誤差累積控制」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；明石海峽大橋的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Arranging bridge types and marine foundations along the strait" and "Trial-assembly survey and error accumulation" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Akashi Kaikyo Bridge must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦9.4 km 海峽上的六座公路鐵路兩用橋：橋型配置、連續懸索橋、共用錨碇、設置沉箱與預壘骨材混凝土；明石海峽大橋則以以數字深入明石海峽大橋：顫振裕度、高強度鋼絲、設置沉箱、地震後幾何修正與主纜乾燥空氣為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on six road–rail bridges across 9.4 km of strait: type selection, continuous suspension spans, a shared anchorage, placed caissons and prepacked concrete; Akashi Kaikyo Bridge centres on numbers behind Akashi Kaikyo: flutter margin, high-strength wire, laid-down caissons, post-quake geometry correction and dry-air cables, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「海峽段 9.4 km 橋型配置」與「桁架加勁梁顫振裕度」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到明石海峽大橋，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「全橋模型試驗與颱風實測比對」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Type layout over 9.4 km” and “Truss flutter margin”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Akashi Kaikyo Bridge, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Full-bridge model tests versus typhoon records", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 瀨戶大橋橋群
history.text: 本州四國連絡橋公團規劃三條連絡路線，瀨戶大橋是其中唯一兼有鐵路的兒島—坂出路線，1978 年 10 月 10 日舉行動土典禮，北、南備讚瀨戶大橋於 1979 年 1 月現場開工，下津井瀨戶大橋於 1981 年、櫃石島橋於 1982 年開工，六座橋於 1988 年 4 月 10 日同時通車。工程以 11 座設置沉箱、預壘骨材水中混凝土、起重船牽引導索與共用錨碇等技術完成，經驗直接延續到明石海峽大橋。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: The Honshu-Shikoku Bridge Authority planned three routes, and Seto Ohashi on the Kojima–Sakaide route is the only one that also carries rail; the ground-breaking ceremony was held on 10 October 1978, site work on Kita and Minami Bisan-Seto began in January 1979, Shimotsui-Seto in 1981 and Hitsuishijima in 1982, and all six bridges opened together on 10 April 1988. The project was completed with eleven placed caissons, prepacked underwater concrete, crane-ship pilot ropes and a shared anchorage, experience that carried directly into the Akashi Kaikyo Bridge. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

references.scopeEn: Pilot rope, catwalk, strand fabrication and transport, cable diameter and tension, shared-anchorage strand counts and hangers.

references.title: 本州四國連絡高速道路：瀨戶大橋施工—加勁桁架設
references.titleEn: Honshu-Shikoku Bridge Expressway: Seto Ohashi construction — stiffening girder erection
references.scope: 工廠全尺寸預組、塔邊大塊吊裝、循環架設與合龍時以千斤頂拉開間隙的方法。
references.scopeEn: Full factory trial assembly, large tower blocks, cyclic erection and jacking the gap open at closure.

roles.role: 業主公開的施工紀錄、維護技術與參觀導覽
roles.roleEn: Owner's public construction records, maintenance technology and site tours
roles.business: 營運瀨戶中央自動車道等本州四國連絡路線，負責長大橋的檢查與維護。
roles.businessEn: Operates the Seto-Chuo Expressway and other Honshu–Shikoku routes, responsible for inspecting and maintaining the long-span bridges.

roles.role: 公路鐵路兩用橋上鐵路營運與作業時段協調的背景
roles.roleEn: Background on rail operation and work-window coordination on a road–rail bridge
roles.business: 經營四國地區鐵路，列車經瀨戶大橋下層往來本州與四國。
roles.businessEn: Operates railways in Shikoku, with trains crossing the lower deck of Seto Ohashi between Honshu and Shikoku.

roles.role: 吊索與結構用鋼索的產品型錄與規格背景
roles.roleEn: Product catalogues and specification background for hanger ropes and structural strands
roles.business: 鋼索與結構用纜索製造商，產品包括橋梁吊索與構造用鋼索。
roles.businessEn: Manufacturer of wire ropes and structural cables, including bridge hanger ropes and structural strands.

courses.connection: 從「瀨戶大橋橋群」的材料、構件、施工或監測延伸到下列公司、業主與機構的官方資料；這是教材關聯，不代表合作、採購或背書。
courses.connectionEn: Explore official information from companies, owners and institutions related to the materials, members, construction or monitoring of Seto Ohashi bridge network. This is a learning association, not a partnership, procurement or endorsement.
